title: SKE CL2000 Menthol Mojito Prefilled Pod + Refill - 20mg
description: Menthol Mojito blends garden Mint with a squeeze of Lime and a cool Menthol finish for a fresh-tasting mix. Each CL2000 replacement pack includes a 1.8ml prefilled pod and a 2.2ml refill container that click together before fitting your CL2000 device. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid support consistent flavour and steady nicotine delivery, with up to 2000 puffs per pack depending on use. To replace: remove the seals, press the pod and refill together until they click, then push the assembled unit into your device until it locks. When both sections are empty, dispose of the parts responsibly and fit a fresh CL2000 pod + refill.
